name: Special Meeting of the City Council (6:30 p.m.) - Study Session
agenda_text:
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE, this special meeting of the City Council has been called by the
Mayor pursuant to Government Code section 54956. Public comments may also be
submitted by email at publiccomments@cityofartesia.us before 12:00 p.m. on the date of
the meeting.

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL – STUDY SESSION
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  ARTESIA, CA 90701
  (562) 865-6262

  YOU MAY VIEW THIS MEETING LIVE OVER THE INTERNET AT
  https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo

  THURSDAY, MAY 23, 2024
  6:30 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER SPECIAL MEETING

ROLL CALL

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

STUDY SESSION
1. REVIEW OF THE PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2024-25 BUDGET
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT  PRESENTATION

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING PUBLIC COMMENTS
Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council is asked to fill out a speaker card and submit it to the
City Clerk prior to the commencement of the meeting. Any public comments that cannot be heard
within the next 20 minutes will be heard at the end of the meeting. Under California law, public
comments at special meetings are limited to subjects on the agenda only.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special
assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-
6262 at least 24 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are on file in the Office of the
City Clerk and are available for inspection.
minutes_text:
ARTESIA  COUNCIL
  CITY  SPECIAL  MEETING  MINUTES
  THURSDAY,  MAY  23, 2024  - 6:30P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL  CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE  AVENUE
  ARTESIA,  CALIFORNIA

CALL  TO ORDER  SPECIAL  MEETING
Mayor  Lima  called  the meeting  to order  at 6:31  p.m.

ROLL  CALL
Present:  Mayor  Lima,  Mayor  Pro Tem  Taj, Councilmembers  Manalo,  Ramoso,  and
Trevino
Staff  Present:  City  Schindler,
  Manager  Deputy City Manager  Burke, Finance  Manager
Murguia,  City Clerk Alderete,  City  Attorney  Nguyen, Public Works  Manager  Sanchez,
Community  Development  Director  Dor, Parks & Recreation  Manager  Guerra

COUNCILMEMBER  COMMENTS
Mayor  Lima, Mayor  Pro Tem Taj, Councilmembers  Trevino,  Ramoso,  and  Manalo
asked  questions and/or provided comments.

STUDY  SESSION
I.  REVIEW  OF THE PROPOSED  FISCAL YEAR 2024-25  BUDGET
Finance  Manager  Murguia presented  the proposed  Fiscal  Year 2024-25  budget.  Mayor
Lima, Mayor  Pro Tem Taj, Councilmembers  Trevino,  Ramoso,  and  Manalo  asked
questions  and/or provided comments.

ANNOUNCEMENT  REGARDING  PUBLIC  COMMENTS
Public comments  could  be  provided,  in  person  or  submitted  by  email  to

publiccomments@cityofartesia.us  by 12:00 p.m. on the date of the meeting. Daniel Richa
and Marcia  Alfaro  provided  comments.

COUNCILMEMBER  COMMENTS
Mayor Lima, and Councilmember  Manalo  asked  questions  and/or  provided  comments.

ADJOURNMENT
Mayor Lima adjourned  the special  meeting  at 7:34  p.m.

Jennifer  Alderete,  City Clerk
